column1: # Native gates (spu rounds 15-16): lifted SPU functions that hand over to a native host implementation when its job's
# env flag is set (port/kz2/spu/). tools/spu/lift_spu.py inserts the gate as the first statement of each listed
# function (KZ2 1.29 images); the slot indexes g_kz2_native_gate[] (defined in the generated spu_workloads.c, filled by
# port/kz2/spu/kz2_native_jobs.c). A gate function returns 1 when it ran the whole subroutine (the lifted body is
# skipped and the function returns to its link as `bi $r0`), 0 to run the lifted body. An earlier change: an optional 7th column
# (cont, an LS address) makes a "continue at" gate for code that is no subroutine: on 1 the gate hops to that address.

the whole pass: 129-entry curve from the table, then per pixel curve(f) x clamp(lum, coverage) x colour, RGBA8 or 16-bit channels out (the shared routine 0x4178 inside)
the whole pass: 129-entry curve of the table bytes, per pixel curve(weighted channel sum) into the first byte of the r6 pixel (the shared routine 0x4178 inside)
the whole pass: every channel times a per-channel 8.8 fixed-point factor (cfltu of the factor quadword), RGBA8 (low byte of the product >> 8) or 16-bit channels (signed mpy, >> 8, clamped at 0xFFFF)
the whole pass: RGBA8 or 16-bit (>> 4) source channels times scale/255 clamped to [0, 1], channel 0 replaced by the weighted sum (0, 0.3, 0.59, 0.11), times 255 to RGBA8
the pass from its row loop to its return (prologue lifted): 8-tap radial blur, taps at the pixel's position times 8 constants, integer weights, clamp, bits 8-15
the whole pass: per pixel colour/255 times clamp(1 - (x^2 + y^2)^2, 0, 1) over x, y in [-1, 1), channel 0 cleared, one word store per pixel
the whole pass: per float clamp(fma(a, d, b), 0, 1) times (c * 255 / 256), cfltu 2^8 into the top byte of the word
2x2 box of RGBA8 pixels (avgb of the rows, then of the even and odd pixels), 4 output pixels a step
8-byte pixels (16-bit channels): per row (p0 + p2) >> 1, (p1 + p3) >> 1, their sum >> 1; one output pixel per source row of the pair, 2 a step
the memset the pass tail-branches to (whole quadwords, then a masked partial quadword)
the whole pass: each apron row unpacked once (host buffer by global row), phase 1 skipped where phase 2 does not read it, the LS left as the SPU leaves it
bit-packed three-component decoder called 3x @0x10D78 (loop 0x13428): (s, e, m) fields per component, fourth = sqrt(1 - sum of squares) at index spec & 3, stored at r5 + 48 idx

keyframe sampler called 3x @0x10D78 (loop 0x125A8): per element a key bitmask (popcounts, first and last set bits against the frame masks) locates two keys in a packed stream, both decoded as 0x13100 (per-element specs), blended by t = (r13 + d_next) / (d_next + d_prev): slerp (acos and sin series, lerp above 0.999) for rotations, lerp with w = 1 otherwise, stored at r18 + 48 idx (an earlier change gate; native an earlier change)
